OK so let me rewrite t3.py properly with correct frame type bytes and correct indices. Let me be careful this time.

Frame type reference:
0x08 plain (id + data)
0x09 FIN (id + data)
0x0a LEN (id + length + data)
0x0b LEN|FIN
0x0c OFF (id + offset + data)
0x0d OFF|FIN
0x0e OFF|LEN (id + offset + length + data)
0x0f OFF|LEN|FIN

def sf_len(sid, length, data): return b'\x0a'+v(sid)+v(length)+data
def sf_lenfin(sid,length,data): return b'\x0b'+v(sid)+v(length)+data
